title: Four path payments in a fee bump: two succeed through a liquidity pool, then NO_TRUST and SRC_NO_TRUST
pattern: Inside a fee bump, operations 0 and 1 report success with liquidity-pool claim atoms, operation 2 fails with no_trust and operation 3 with src_no_trust (the source holds no trustline for the asset it sends). The inner transaction failed: none of the pool trades happened.

hazards.placement: PathPaymentStrictSendResult.PATH_PAYMENT_STRICT_SEND_SRC_NO_TRUST at op 3 of a failed inner tx
txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED whose inner results mix pool trades and two failure codes
liquidity-pool claim atoms in the success result of an op inside a failed transaction

facts.says: Operation 0 reports a trade through pool LAGSLLBP…, which did not happen.
